evals.name: bm-gym
evals.prompt: I own a small gym and only have about $1,000 for marketing. Using the Brick & Mortar Funnels book, how would Alex Hormozi get 100 members in 100 days? Include the numbers.
assertions: Explains client-financed acquisition (point-of-sale cash covers this customer AND the next)
Recommends high-ticket packages/challenge offers instead of a cheap commodity membership (e.g., 6-Week challenge, $99/week tiers)
Gives the ~$1,100 average cash per sale (e.g., 1 whale $2,500, 1 above average $1,200, 3 normal $600 out of 5 sales from 10 prospects)
Calculates spend per show (~$550 per show at 50% close, so ~$275 per show)
Describes the funnel: ad -> opt-in -> scheduling page -> Facebook group, and contacting all leads
Mentions the follow-on sales (food, supplements, 12-month, paid in full) and/or the $1 -> $3 reinvestment rule

evals.name: bm-home-service
evals.prompt: I run a window cleaning company. Per the Brick & Mortar Funnels book, how do I figure out how much I can spend to get a customer and what offers and steps should I use to get 100 new clients?
assertions: Explains max CAC = annual revenue per client x profit margin (e.g., $40 x 30 = $1,200 x 25% = $300)
Explains the value ladder / front-end offers (e.g., 10 exterior windows for $99)
Says to build one landing page per single offer (not a broad website)
Lists ad copy elements: hook headline, body, benefits, urgency/scarcity
Covers traffic sources including emailing existing clients, Facebook posts/Live, and Facebook ads, then measuring results
Adds at least one other expert tactic from the book (e.g., Shaule reactivation/SMS or review/referral funnel, Frey referrals)

evals.name: bm-dentist
evals.prompt: I'm a dentist. What does the Brick & Mortar Funnels book recommend to get 100 new patients in 100 days, and how would I get reviews and referrals?
assertions: Describes Anissa Holmes' four-phase plan with day ranges (1-45 warm audience; 46-50 funnels; 51-80 nurture; 81-100 traffic)
Includes the local business gift card giveaway and smile makeover competition
Mentions building Facebook retargeting audiences and training the team on phone conversion
Mentions high-value treatment funnels (implants, Invisalign) and/or the 30-Day Floss Challenge
Covers reviews/referrals via Tyler Shaule's NPS rate-review-referral funnel (~300 five-star reviews) or similar book method
Includes compliance cautions (e.g., TCPA/SMS consent, HIPAA/testimonials, review gating)
